item.title: How to use switchMap operator in Angular
item.description: The switchMap operator is essential for handling scenarios where you need to cancel previous observable emissions and switch to new ones. As the creator of CoreUI, I use switchMap extensively for search functionality and dependent HTTP requests. The most common use case is implementing live search where each keystroke should cancel the previous search request. This prevents race conditions and ensures only the latest result is processed.
